Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 3.1% to $1.9B in 2025. Gross margin was 92.3%, versus 92.9% a year earlier, and operating income fell 13.0% to $80.0M, a 4.2% margin.
Net income rose 8.0× to $40.0M, or $0.31 per share. Operating cash flow was $245M and free cash flow $163M, versus $70.0M; Tripadvisor returned $90.0M through buybacks.
sources: Tripadvisor, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
